description: The finished report. Call it first with failedOnly: true and view: "digest": results, total and nextOffset then cover only the pages that failed, one small object per page with its issues, diff percentage and largest visual regions, and a one-line-per-page text block, while summary still covers every page. check_page and diff_deploy return the first regressed region's image; get_screenshot (?surface=full) fetches a region by filename. Without view, each result is { path, status, failedChecks } by default; responseFormat: "detailed" returns the full per-check fields, diffs and screenshot names. Without failedOnly, a slice of every page's result (offset and limit, default 50 a call, at most 5000; nextOffset points at the next slice). The text block is the plain-text report over the slice; includeText: true also puts it in structuredContent.text. limit: 1 returns the summary with one result. The digest carries each page's fingerprints and flakyShare; a change whose flakyShare is at least 0.5 is likely the page moving on its own, so mask the element its fingerprint names (visual.masks on the next job) instead of treating it as a regression. Do not call it while the job runs: wait_for_comparison first. Free.

failedOnly.description: Only pages whose status is fail: results, total, nextOffset and text then cover the failed pages alone, while summary still covers every page.

includeText.description: Also return the plain-text report over the slice as structuredContent.text; the text block carries it either way.

jobId.description: The jobId returned when the job was created, e.g. web-1a2b3c or cmp-1a2b3c.

jobToken.description: The jobToken returned when the job was created. Optional when the request’s HTTP headers carry the key that paid the job.

limit.description: Page results to return (at most 5000; default 1000 on REST, 50 over MCP).

offset.description: Index of the first page result to return (default 0).

responseFormat.description: concise (default): each result is { path, status, failedChecks }, plus snapshots when a side was read from a stored snapshot; detailed: the full per-check fields, diffs and screenshot names of every result.

view.description: full (default) returns every page result with its diffs and screenshots plus text; digest returns one small object per page (status, failed checks, issues, diff percentage) and no text. Combine digest with failedOnly=true to keep the response small.
